games.name: Chodd
games.description: The council of gods has no ruler, and you intend to keep it that way. A Difficult Coop roguelike: march your Warp Core across a hostile world, command your goons in real time, and play scheming gods against each other so none grow strong enough to stop you.

games.name: An incremental city from a word search: Wordhood
games.description: Build an incremental town powered by word searches. Wordhood is an addictive blend of finding words and watching numbers grow. Gather resources, combine upgrades, and unleash combos to grow a hungry town.

games.name: Cook & Sail
games.description: A 1-4 player co-op restaurant that happens to be a ship. Work the day as a crew, keep hungry customers from walking out, and spend what you make on a vessel that can actually handle the job. The tables want a good meal. The fleet wants its share.

games.name: FATHOM
games.description: Send your crew deep into an alien ocean in this pixel-art desktop companion idler. Research strange creatures, harvest and refine resources, expand your deep-sea research platform, and discover the secrets lurking beneath the waves.

games.name: Oceanarium Fishing
games.description: Fish, explore and survive in a co-op horror adventure for 1–4 players. Brave the ocean, upgrade your boat and build your aquarium. But save enough of your catch to feed the island’s Keeper: its daily quota is growing, and the water hides more than fish.

games.name: Compicactus
games.description: Compi is a little cactus on your windowsill, and it wants to keep a diary. Help it write about your days with a few taps: the people you love, what you did and how you felt. Watch it grow and bloom, dress it up, and read your days as Compi saw them.

games.name: Caboosh
games.description: Caboosh! is a roguelite where you build a train one silly wagon at a time. Every car has its own effects and synergies, so line up the combos, stack the crates waaay up high and pray the money outruns the fuel bill!

games.name: 9 Box
games.description: Ten players. Nine boxes. Grab a box, pick one of two abilities, take aim — then every ability fires at the same moment. Fast, chaotic online battles for up to 10 toys in a giant kid's bedroom. Matches last under 5 minutes.

games.name: Haunted! But Sorted.
games.description: It's 1996. Wojak needs money, and his girlfriend Dodoo is counting on him. His job: the night shift at a shop in the middle of a graveyard. Haul in deliveries, sort every product and keep one eye on the dark. Play solo or co-op, but don't go outside alone.

games.name: Mad Scientist Simulator – Society of World Destruction
games.description: Run a mad science shop by day, pilot a giant robot by night. In this 1-4 player co-op comedy sim you stock shelves, brew unstable potions and expose undercover agents - then split the robot's controls with your friends to flatten 5 cities and beat 5 superheroes.

games.name: SlotsNStocks
games.description: Rig the market in this deckbuilding slot machine roguelite. Draft hundreds of bullish and bearish symbols, build money-making combinations, and manipulate the odds in your favor. Adapt to an ever-shifting market and make enough to survive your next margin call.

games.name: Paradice Run Club
games.description: Roll dice, gather resources, and hit the target! Paradice Run Club is a precision strategy roguelike where players get as close as possible to a target number. Compete with other runners or against your own records to follow those targets as they climb from 17, to 21, to 100!

games.name: Überlauf
games.description: Build a mine with cards on a freshly rolled voxel island: place mines, lay belts, smelt ore into ingots. You get 75 seconds per round. Then your jokers multiply the takings until the number catches fire. A roguelike blend of factory building and cards.

games.name: Gun Party
games.description: Roll for stars. Sabotage your friends. Gun Party packs 5 boards and 79 mini-games into one chaotic party night, from cart crashes to crew disasters and horror rounds. Play with 2–10 online or up to 4 in couch split-screen. Full controller support. Add bots to any match.

games.name: SERPENTER
games.description: A fast, colorful 3D snake adventure across 9 floating worlds and 63 levels! Dodge crumbling floors, slippery ice and wild hazards, unleash power-ups, tackle endless runs and daily challenges, or play with up to 4 friends. Help Zip find Ray!

games.name: Curator: Tidy Up the Sleeping Gallery!
games.description: Become the curator of a vast, magical museum! In this relaxing game, find the right place for over 3,000 paintings, restore damaged works and uncover their fascinating stories. Upgrade your curator, work faster and unlock new galleries!

games.name: Pimple Pop
games.description: Get up close. Really, really close. Squeeze pimples, scrape plaque, roll out earwax, pluck nose hairs and trim nails in 21 levels of ultra-detailed close-up work. Be gentle, be precise, and never touch the eardrum. Earn 3 stars on every level and unlock them all.

games.name: Hair Stylist Simulator
games.description: Every client brings a photo. Match it with your scissors and clippers before time runs out, then shampoo, blow-dry and sweep up. Run your own salon, cut 8 different styles for 8 clients, and earn five stars. Cut too much and you can't put it back!

games.name: Switchroom
games.description: You were naughty this year. Now you're stuck in Santa's warehouse with your friends. Every switch might drop a toy, kill the lights or let something in. Find the toys on the list, ship them, and survive each other.

games.name: Gnome Cottage Cleanup!
games.description: A whimsical organizing simulator about tracking down thousands of Gnomes, Plants, Books, Potions and more! Use magical abilities and upgrades on your quest to sort 4,060 items scattered across the Gnome Cottage. Just pure exploration, organizing, and collecting with no time limits or pressure.

games.name: A Game About Feeding Pigeons
games.description: Relax and build the ultimate pigeon sanctuary! Start with basic crumbs, scatter seed, and attract dozens of unique birds. Upgrade your feed, unlock automated machines, and discover beautiful new locations in this cozy idle incremental game.

games.name: Bet Your Friends
games.description: Shocking twist on Monopoly, your FRIENDS now become your prized ASSETS! BUY, WORK, BID or GAMBLE. First one to REACH $1,000,000 WINS! Have YOU ever bet with your FRIEND'S LIFE on the line?

games.name: Gravity well
games.description: Explore vast galaxies through gravity wells and realistic physics. Launch and combine celestial bodies to uncover mysterious stories hidden in space. Race friends and players worldwide for the top spot, or slow down and enjoy a tranquil deep-space atmosphere beneath the stars.

games.name: Flag Boom! Chronicles
games.description: Plant your flag on a fort and your WHOLE ARMY DOUBLES! A pixel-art RTS where hundreds of archers, spearmen and cavalry clash in a rock-paper-scissors war. Pick a unit type, march, seize forts and watch your army explode. 20 stages, 4 giant bosses.

games.name: Corner Club
games.description: A tiny pixel nightclub living in the corner of your desktop. Put on any music and the dancers move on its beat!

games.name: Fish Fish Pop
games.description: A slow, cozy match-three under the sea. Swap, pop, and pick a new card every round. Thirty rounds, no timer, and you can't lose. The only question is how few moves you need. Oh, and the sea has secrets.

games.name: Her in the Abyss
games.description: You accidentally intercept a distress signal from space—a girl codenamed C804 is venturing alone into a forbidden zone. Game time runs in perfect real-time sync with reality; every response, every silence, shapes her actions and decisions.

games.name: Zoo Life Tycoon
games.description: Inherit a run-down zoo at the edge of town and turn it into the pride of the city. Repair pens, care for 21 species, welcome families and juggle your own life too: eat, sleep, make friends and upgrade your home in this cozy pixel-art zoo tycoon and life sim.

games.name: Carry Crew
games.description: "There’s room for one more!" Pick your cargo, pile it onto a board, and grab opposite ends in this couch co-op adventure for two. When the ice cracks underfoot, jump together on three. You both made it across. Did your cargo?

games.name: Pinball Bonanza Live
games.description: Run a live stream from your garage and build a seven-floor pinball machine with your viewers’ donations. Flip, nudge and chase multiball while chat cheers you on — then automate it all in a hands-on incremental pinball game.

games.name: Stay Lit
games.description: You're the last ember. He's the jerk who blew out the rest. Roll through 130 trap-packed levels in 26 worlds while Snuff, a shadow imp, rigs each level right in front of you and takes notes on how you play, so the level changes after you die.

games.name: Maiden Taskbar
games.description: A little adventure begins at the bottom of your screen. Keep this idle RPG running above your taskbar and build a squad of maidens from 100+ cards across five races.

games.name: Let 'er Ride
games.description: A Wild West roguelike based on casino Let It Ride. Post three bets, then pull them home or let ’em ride as the Board turns. Hire a posse of oddballs, beat crooked Proprietors at their own rules, and win Her back from the Baron.

games.name: Why Does the Ball Fall?
games.description: An idle and clicker game about dropping balls, over and over. Hit a goal hole and the ball rolls one lane deeper; miss and it is gone. Spend coins to seal holes, widen the goals and unlock fruit and animal balls, then keep descending lanes that go on forever.

games.name: Bottom Feeders: Crab Crew
games.description: Haul up crab pots with 1–6 friends in this silly co-op crabbing game. Throw pots off the pier, pull up 37 kinds of ridiculous crabs, sell them, and trade your leaky rowboat for a solid gold yacht. Or just shove your crew into the sea.

games.name: Paint The Wall
games.description: 400 meters of bare concrete. Out you go! Paint the Wall is a satisfying painting sim where the higher you climb, the more you earn. Upgrade to paint cannons and hot air balloons, hire robots and drones, and paint it all, solo or with friends. That wall won't paint itself!

games.name: Smash Arena
games.description: An online party game for up to 12 players: brick-built toys clash in wild, physics-driven challenges. Run, jump, shove, survive the glass bridge and Red Light… and climb onto the podium. Dress up your toy and challenge your friends!

games.name: Bubble Tea Simulator
games.description: Run a cozy little bubble tea café with up to six friends. Cook the pearls, shake the drinks and keep the queue smiling, then close up, pile into bed and wake up ready to open your next branch. Play solo or in online co-op.

games.name: AquaScape Desk
games.description: A planted aquarium sim that lives on your desktop. Build a hardscape from stones and driftwood, plant it, and let the fish swim. Plants grow in real time, so trimming matters. You can even scan real stones and driftwood and drop them straight in. Reef tanks with corals, too.

games.name: Christmas TCG Tidy Up Together
games.description: Tidy up nearly 5,000 festive trading cards scattered across the floor of a Christmas TCG store, solo or with up to two friends online. Clean your finds and complete 15 festive sets in regular and holo finishes. Earn coins for boosters packs, hunt for exclusive rare cards.

games.name: Build a Sand Castle
games.description: Build a Sand Castle. Complete the task from the rich man and earn yourself 1M Dollars. The Castle is Enormous so you will be here for a while... But it would be faster if you used the Abilities and "Sugar" the man gave to you.

games.name: My Little Animal Care Center
games.description: Run a cozy little animal clinic in the heart of a colorful town! Treat hurt pets on the care table, pamper your boarders in their pens, welcome over a dozen species and grow your small center into a whole neighborhood of care.

games.name: Tiny Winter Market
games.description: Build and decorate your own cozy Christmas market in a charming pixel-art winter village! Welcome visitors, manage festive stalls, help Santa deliver presents, discover hidden surprises, and enjoy the magic of Christmas in Tiny Winter Market.

games.name: DeadLoop
games.description: DeadLoop is a competitive arena action game for 2–4 players, combining monster-wave survival with PvP duels. Choose a hero, buy items, and upgrade abilities between battles. Bet in-match gold on duel outcomes and turn smart decisions into an advantage over your rivals.

games.name: Paschalis TD
games.description: Build and upgrade towers to defend yourself against various enemies.

games.name: GALLOP
games.description: Ride, explore and puzzle your way across a wild medieval land with your friends. Reach the far-off castle, rescue the queen and return her to the king – past bandit ambushes, untamed nature and the occasional friendly shove off a cliff.

games.name: You Don't Have to Be a Hero!
games.description: A cozy raising sim inspired by Princess Maker. As homeroom teacher, spend three years beside one student at Sebit Academy: plan her weeks, share small everyday moments, and help her find a future of her own. She doesn't have to be a hero.

games.name: Quest Dice
games.description: A solo gamebook with a real, physics-rolled d20. Read the story, make your choices, roll the dice and live with the result. Create your hero, play handcrafted adventures in 22 languages, or write and share your own books.

games.name: ALL PASSENGERS BUCKLE UP
games.description: Run a budget airline in 1-6 player co-op. Check passports, load the bags, fly the route and keep the passengers fed while the jet catches fire around you. Take bribes, dodge storms and climb onto the roof mid-flight. Hit the quota or the whole crew is fired.

games.name: Million Layer Gift Simulator
games.description: A giant gift with 1,000,000 layers of wrapping paper. Peel it strip by strip, sell the paper, and buy better tools, from nail clippers to a leaf blower. Play alone or with up to 4 friends. What’s inside? There’s only one way to find out.

games.name: Void Drive
games.description: Chain your cars together and drive across roads hanging over the void. If one falls, everyone falls. Jump, crash and laugh through 17 trap-filled worlds with up to 3 friends online, or go solo and chase your best time.

games.name: Lost in the Post
games.description: Fly a rickety hot-air balloon with 2-4 friends and deliver the mail across a world that wants you dead. Work the burner, drop the ballast, catch the parcels, slap your crewmates, and try not to fall out. We always deliver. Mostly.

games.name: Bot Jump
games.description: Jump, shoot and keep moving in Bot Jump, a side-scrolling platformer for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Guide little robots through changing scenery, blast enemies out of the way and link up with friends by rope. How far can you go together?

games.name: A Sheet-ton of Bingo
games.description: Fill one whole bingo sheet out of a thousand before the old regular across the hall yells BINGO. Call numbers, dab squares and buy auto-daubers in this incremental race to find the bingo in a sheet haystack. He has been doing this for decades. You have no idea how good he is.

games.name: No, I'm Not Addicted to Opening Packs
games.description: Rip open packs in this incremental trading card game! Collect hundreds of unique cards across themed sets, upgrade your packs, sacrifice cards for rewards and complete challenges to earn stars for permanent upgrades. Chase the rarest pulls and build your ultimate collection!

games.name: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone
games.description: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone is a neon top-down shooter. Customize your ship's left and right cannons, fight through branching rooms, collect gear, and build powerful weapon combos. Face geometric enemies, elite threats, and multi-phase bosses.

games.name: FootBall Inc
games.description: Take direct control of the rods in a physics-driven foosball game, then build the club behind every match. Master powerful shots, sign and develop players, climb four divisions, upgrade your facilities, and earn your place at the World Cup.

games.name: PokerCat Battle
games.description: Turn poker hands into powerful attacks in a fantasy adventure starring a sword-wielding cat. Bend your hand with Tarot cards, battle bosses, collect gear, and grow stronger. Play each hand yourself or let auto-battle run in a compact desktop bar.

games.name: Bitnook
games.description: A cozy idle game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Tiny Bit Friends guard your desktop from mischievous bugs while you work: they fight, build and grow on their own, and parade out to tell you what they did when you come back.

games.name: Magical Girl: incremental gaiden
games.description: Start as a weak Magical Girl and become an unstoppable force! Fight weird Shadows, collect resources, unlock powerful upgrades, and annihilate the Witches in this Incremental Bullet Hell!
